title: Constraints and indexes on a table this script created are not production risk
expected_feedback: No violations. Every object here is built on ORDERS_NEW, which this same script creates: nothing reads or writes it until cutover, so the index build blocks no DML and the primary key validates an empty or freshly-loaded segment. Applying the ONLINE keyword or the ENABLE NOVALIDATE two-step to an interim table would be ceremony — those exist to protect concurrent traffic, and there is none. Flagging this would make the standard CTAS and DBMS_REDEFINITION patterns unusable, since both necessarily build a second table. The judgement changes the moment ORDERS_NEW is renamed into place; from then on it is live and the normal rules apply.
